system.one_liner: Explains a distribution shift with interpretable transport maps (k-sparse, k-cluster, distribution translation) chosen by data type.

content.variant_note: a left-to-right flowchart of two questions whose three branches end in grey result boxes, each putting a baseline explanation beside the proposed one on a real example
content.argues: Different data call for different interpretable maps, and each map explains the shift better than a baseline explanation on a real example.
content.subject: A flowchart that picks k-sparse, k-cluster or distribution translation maps, with a baseline-versus-proposed result for each.

lessons.what_to_learn: Turn method selection into a flowchart: rounded question boxes with answers on the arrows lead to one solver box per case, and every branch ends in a grey result box that shows the baseline output beside the proposed output on the same real example.
lessons.suits: Papers that offer several variants of one method for different data types and want to show both how to choose one and what each gains over a baseline.

evidence: we suggest following the logical flow for method selection in Figure 1
a user can choose to explain the distribution shift using k-sparse maps

summary: The paper explains distribution shifts with interpretable transport maps from a source to a target distribution. Figure 1 is a method-selection flowchart. Given the datasets P_src (blue) and P_tgt (red), a first question asks whether features or samples are interpretable; for interpretable features a second asks whether the samples form clusters. The three branches lead to solvers for k-sparse maps, k-cluster maps and distribution translation maps, each ending in a grey result box that sets a baseline explanation beside the proposed one: word lists for toxic comments, cluster scatter plots, and histology image grids. A dotted frame called Our Methods groups the flow and its results.
summary_zh: 本文用可解释的传输映射来解释分布偏移。图 1 是方法选择流程图：给定源分布和目标分布，先问特征或样本是否可解释，再问是否有簇，三条分支分别求 k 稀疏、k 聚类和分布翻译映射，每条分支的灰框里并排给出基线解释与所提解释。
notes: Pre-screen kinds kept. The three grey result boxes are separately framed but have no letter or title, so they are treated as the ends of three lanes, not as panels. The scatter plots are vector (hundreds of marker paths in the digest); the oracle blob sketch, the cylinders and the histology grids are bitmaps by placed size. The system has no name in the paper, so name is null.
